title: Case 06: The Silent Broadcast
subtitle: A radio host collapses live on air at 11:17 PM. The final thirty seconds of his broadcast repeat word-for-word in every loop.
loop_reset_text: The ON AIR lamp flashes backward. The host's last sentence rewinds into his mouth. It is 10:52 PM again.

studio.name: Broadcast Studio
studio.description: A locked booth, a live microphone and a coffee cup beside a host who should still be speaking.

control.name: Control Room
control.description: Waveforms, automation logs and one suspiciously perfect thirty-second segment.

rooftop.name: Rooftop Transmitter
rooftop.description: Rain needles the antenna deck. Access logs place someone here during the crucial minute.

archive.name: Archive Basement
archive.description: Old tapes, donor files and a missing recording connect the station's past to tonight's murder.

nadia.name: Nadia Vale
dialogue: I never entered the booth after 10:45.
The host changed his own coffee order.
You keep asking about the bracelet. It means nothing.

contradiction.result: Chemical residue and the metallic bracelet strike on the mic prove Nadia entered after 11:00 and handled the poisoned drink.

nadia.asma_open: Watch Nadia Vale. Do not decide too early. Ask one thing at a time and listen for what changes.
tells: Nadia Vale answers quickly, but their eyes move toward the nearest exit.
This time Nadia Vale reacts before you finish the question. They remember nothing, but the pattern changed.
Nadia Vale tries to repeat the same wording. One detail is different.
nadia.pressure_line: You should not know that part yet.
nadia.shadow_reveal: Nadia Vale changes route after the interview and briefly checks a place they never mentioned.

marcus.name: Marcus Reed
dialogue: I was in makeup during the final break.
We argued, but only about airtime.
The repeated line sounded live to me.

contradiction.result: Makeup-room timing clears Marcus while the duplicated waveform proves the final segment was not live.

contradiction.result: Felix manipulated the broadcast, but the edit happened after the poisoning. He covered the timeline, not the murder.

timeline: 11:08 PM — Host drinks from his cup.
11:16 PM — Automation switches from live feed.
deduction_prompt: Who poisoned the host and used the prerecorded broadcast to disguise the real time of death?
truth: Nadia poisoned the host after learning he planned to expose the station's hidden finances. Felix's prerecorded segment made the host appear alive after he was already dying, but Nadia's bracelet click and poison residue place her inside the booth during the true murder window.
partial: You identify Nadia, but without proving the broadcast was prerecorded the timeline remains vulnerable.
wrong: Your theory cannot explain the duplicated waveform, poisoned cup and Nadia's hidden visit. The ON AIR lamp rewinds.

loop_reveals.2: Look at me. We already know Coffee Cup Residue does not fit. This time, watch Mic-Stand Audio Click before anyone knows we are suspicious.
loop_reveals.3: Something is repeating too precisely. We have Coffee Cup Residue and Mic-Stand Audio Click. Now we find the detail nobody expected us to remember.

action_beats.label: SEARCH THE SCENE WITH ASMA
action_beats.title: SCENE SEARCH
action_beats.text: Asma moves with you through the scene, checking what everyone else ignored. You compare positions, timing, and what looks slightly too deliberate.

action_beats.label: FOLLOW THE MOVEMENT YOU REMEMBER
action_beats.title: PURSUIT
action_beats.text: You move before the moment repeats. Asma follows your lead as you cut across the route you remember from the previous loop.

action_beats.label: TAKE COVER & HOLD POSITION
action_beats.title: TAKE COVER
action_beats.text: The situation turns dangerous. You and Asma take cover, wait for the opening, and move only when the evidence says the risk is worth it.

twist_hint: The obvious explanation for Case 06 is incomplete; one detail only makes sense after the loop repeats.
